title: IMU Callback Registry: subscribe, unsubscribe, re-entrant publish
hints: A `std::map<int, Callback>` keyed by a monotonically increasing id is already in subscription order, and erase-by-id is O(log n).
subscribeMember: wrap it in a lambda `[obj, method](const ImuSample& s) { (obj->*method)(s); }` and forward to subscribe().
Re-entrancy: if a callback erases entries while you iterate the map, your iterator may dangle. Snapshot the ids first, then for each id look it up again (it may have been removed).
Even the callback that's *currently running* can unsubscribe itself, which destroys the std::function you're executing. Invoke a local COPY of the callback.
